_readme: Edit this file to update activities, milestones, collaborators, funding and FAQ, then run: node scripts/render-content.mjs. Text fields may contain simple HTML (<a>, <strong>, <em>). Only add facts with a source or confirmed by the owner. 'status' for activities: 'regular' (shared as recurring), 'project' (time-limited workshop series), 'event' (one-off or annual).

featuredProject.title: Cultural Arts for Holistic Healing of Mind, Body and Spirit
featuredProject.text: A workshop series for seniors in South Markham, facilitated by Island Breeze and funded by United Way Greater Toronto through the South Markham Community Action Grants. Workshops included Drumming for Wellness and Healing Grief Through Poetry, and the project closed with a celebration luncheon and fashion show.

joinSteps.title: Give us a call
joinSteps.text: Call 416-319-7763, or send a message below and ask us to call you back.

joinSteps.title: Ask your questions
joinSteps.text: Ask what's on this month, where to meet, and anything else you'd like to know before you come.

joinSteps.title: Plan your first visit
joinSteps.text: Pick an activity to try first. If anything would make your visit easier, just let us know when you call.

faq.a: Island Breeze describes its programs as serving adults aged 55 and older in Markham. If you're not sure whether a program is right for you or someone you care for, please give us a call.
Call 416-319-7763 and we'll talk you through it. You can also send us a message and ask for a call back.
Costs can vary by activity. Please call us to ask about the activity you're interested in.
Our mission includes older adults and their caregivers. Please call to talk about coming together, so we can plan the visit with you.

faq.q: What are the current program times?
faq.a: Our schedule changes through the year. Please call 416-319-7763 for this month's activities and times.

faq.q: What accessibility or transportation arrangements are available?
faq.a: Please call before your visit so we can talk through access, mobility needs and how you'll get there.

milestones.title: Incorporated as a not-for-profit
milestones.text: Island Breeze Seniors Day Program Ltd. was incorporated under the Canada Not-for-profit Corporations Act.

milestones.title: Guiding Light
milestones.text: Received a $4,000 federal grant for the Guiding Light project through the Supporting Black Communities stream (September 2021 to September 2022).

milestones.title: Moment In Time
milestones.text: Received an $18,750 New Horizons for Seniors Program grant for the Moment In Time project (March 2022 to March 2023).

milestones.title: Part of Carefirst's partner network
